title: Spring Communal Roadmap Checkpoint — Draft Agenda, OKRs and Exec Notes
body:
Purpose:
This is a working draft for the Spring Roadmap Checkpoint and company town/together session. Goal is to align execs and org leads on priorities, surface open risks, and propose a concise set of company-level outcomes (draft OKRs) that we can socialize before the March leadership sync.

Audience:
All executives, product area leads (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private, Console, Optimize), eng managers, and growth/sales leads.

High-level objectives for the session:
- Share short update (5–7 min) from each product area focusing on customer impact and regressions since last quarter.
- Present proposed company outcomes for spring (goal clarity + one-liner metrics).
- Run a 25-minute breakouts + synthesis to gather feedback on risks and cross-org dependencies.
- Agree on owners and timeline to finalize OKRs by 2026-03-18.

Proposed agenda (90 minutes total):
1) 0:00–0:05 — Opening + framing (Priya)
   - Why this checkpoint matters: tighten success metrics for May product milestones.
2) 0:05–0:30 — Rapid area updates (5–6 areas, 5 mins each)
   - Hosted API: Marcus — adoption trends, top 3 incidents since Jan
   - Dedicated: Tamas — capacity commitments and runway risks
   - Private: Ruth — pipeline & pilot indicators for regulated customers
   - Console & Observability: Sofia — rollout cadence and alert noise reduction
   - Optimize & Evals: Jamal — quality regressions, quantization guidance progress
3) 0:30–0:55 — Exec update + topline metrics (Priya + Finance)
   - Revenue/ARR trend, usage growth, CAC signals, committed Dedicated revenue
4) 0:55–1:20 — Breakout sessions (cross-functional groups)
   - Group A: Reliability & SLOs for hosting mixed traffic
   - Group B: Pricing/packaging assumptions + Dedicated expansion playbook
   - Group C: Private deployment sales/ops dependencies (KMS, compliance)
   - Each group: 15 minutes discussion, 5 minutes note-taking
5) 1:20–1:35 — Synthesis of breakout and decision points
6) 1:35–1:30 — Next steps & owners (closing)

Draft company-level outcomes (spring window: Mar–May 2026) — very rough, targets to be sharpened:
- Outcome 1 (Reliability & Latency): Improve real-world tail latency for the Hosted API so that P95 text-generation latency for typical 512-token calls decreases by 12% while maintaining error rate < 0.25%. Owner: Marcus. Metric: P95 latency baseline = 420ms (Feb), target = <= 370ms.
- Outcome 2 (Cost per Inference): Reduce per-1000-token unit cost on common inference paths by 10% via batching and kernel selection improvements. Owner: Tamas + Serving Runtime. Metric: internal cost model comparison to Jan baseline.
- Outcome 3 (Platform Growth): Reach 1,200 monthly active developer accounts using the hosted API (up from 900). Owner: Growth/Product. Metric: MAUs, conversion rate from free tier.
- Outcome 4 (Enterprise Confidence & Private): Close 3 Private deployment pilots into paid contracts and deliver an audit-ready Private package for two regulated verticals. Owner: Ruth. Metric: number of signed pilots -> contracts.
- Outcome 5 (Quality Monitoring): Ship end-to-end eval regression alerts tied to production prompts and integrate into the Console (beta). Owner: Jamal. Metric: eval regression detection time and number of flagged regressions per month.

Open questions / trade-offs to discuss:
- Aggressiveness of cost optimization: how much quality risk are we willing to accept for the 10% cost target? (Engineering vs Product trade-off)
- Dedicated capacity pricing: do we preserve enterprise margin by increasing minimum commitments or by adding a premium SLA tier? (Sales + Finance)
- Private deployment cadence: accept a slower but higher-margin sales funnel vs faster, lower-touch pilot conversion?

Key risks and mitigations (brief):
- Risk: Kernel selection changes could cause edge-case regressions for specialty models. Mitigation: gated rollout with canary variant and rollback hooks; expand eval coverage for top 20 customer prompts.
- Risk: Too many simultaneous rollouts (console, batching, quant) increases incident blast radius. Mitigation: cross-team rollout calendar + preflight checklist in release-engineering.
- Risk: Sales pipeline for Private requires legal & compliance ramp for each vertical. Mitigation: productize an audit kit and prioritize two verticals this quarter.

Decision register (what we need to decide at this checkpoint):
- Finalize numeric OKR targets by 2026-03-18 (owner alignment required).
- Approve increased Dedicated minimum commitment or defer to pricing experiment.
- Confirm roadmap freeze dates for major infra changes (batching/quant) around mid-April to reduce risk to commercial launches.

Prep required from area leads before the session (deliverables):
- One-pager slide (1 slide) per area with: 3 bullets of current state, 1 metric that moved, 1 ask/decision. Deadline: 2026-03-10. Owner: area leads.
- Short risk register table (top 5 risks) uploaded to Confluence page. Deadline: 2026-03-12. Owner: eng managers.
- Draft OKR metrics in this doc: update the numeric baselines and data source links. Deadline: 2026-03-14. Owner: Priya + Finance + Growth.

Communication plan:
- Pre-read sent 3 days before the session with a 2-paragraph executive note.
- 48-hour reminder with logistical details and breakout assignments.
- Post-session: synthesis memo + finalized OKRs published to Confluence and shared drive; product area owners confirm committed sub-OKRs within 1 week.

Notes to self / things to finish in this draft:
- Embed chart: Hosted API P95 latency trend (Jan–Feb) — Marcus to drop CSV into Confluence and link here.
- Validate MAU baseline with Growth (Marcus/Sofia).
- Create rollout calendar mock in release-engineering and link.

Open items for the leadership review meeting on 2026-03-05:
- Finance to present ARPU and margin sensitivity for Dedicated pricing options. (Finance owner: Elena Park)
- Legal to confirm time estimate for audit kit packaging for two verticals. (Legal owner: Daniel Osei)
- SRE to confirm expected incident risk window for kernel rollout. (SRE owner: Keiko Tanaka)

Action items (owner, due):
- Marcus: populate latency chart + single-slide area update (due 2026-03-10).
- Tamas: quant/batching impact memo with estimated cost delta (due 2026-03-12).
- Ruth: status on Private pilot pipeline and proposed 3 target pilots (due 2026-03-09).
- Jamal: sample eval alerts and alert runbook draft (due 2026-03-11).
- Priya: finalize exec pre-read and circulate (due 2026-03-12).

Feedback loop:
- Please add comments in this doc (suggested edits in-line) or drop quick notes in #leadership-planning Slack.
- If you can't make the session, record a 3-minute update and upload to the linked folder.

Misc context (short):
- We committed to reducing unit inference cost in last quarter planning; this is the operational checkpoint where engineering proposals meet pricing experiments.
- Dedicated backlog is showing stronger-than-expected interest from two enterprise accounts — this makes the pricing decision time-sensitive.

End of draft.

(Version history notes)
- v0.1 2026-02-14 initial draft (Priya)
- v0.2 2026-02-21 added breakout topics and draft outcomes (collaborators)
- v0.3 2026-03-02 updated owners and action dates after sync with Finance
